parameters.name: AliyunLang
parameters.description:
The language. Default value: zh. Valid values:

*   zh
*   en

parameters.name: GrafanaWorkspaceEdition
parameters.description:
The edition.

**Valid values:**

*   standard: `Beta Edition or Standard Edition`
*   personal_edition: Developer Edition
*   experts_edition: Pro Edition
*   advanced_edition: Advanced Edition

parameters.name: GrafanaWorkspaceName
parameters.description: The name of the Grafana workspace.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password of the workspace. The password must be 8 to 30 characters in length. It must include at least three of the following characters types: uppercase letter, lowercase letter, digit, and special character. Special characters include () ' ~ ! @ # $ % ^ & \* - \_ + =.

parameters.name: PricingCycle
parameters.description: 包年包月的计费周期，取值： Month（默认值）：按月购买。                                 Year：按年购买。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms create-grafana-workspace --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --grafana-workspace-name testgrafana --grafana-workspace-edition experts_edition --description test --grafana-version 10.0.x --password 'Test123456!' --auto-renew false --pricing-cycle Month --duration 6 --account-number 10 --custom-account-number 0 --aliyun-lang zh --resource-group-id rg-acfmxyexli20000 --tags Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
